purpose: Feasibility and efficiency research for the take-home; retrieval and ZIP verified, email integration not implemented

methodology.browser: Google Chrome via Playwright; available computer-use Chrome connector returned unavailable
methodology.benchmark: Two runs per initial configuration in reversed order, plus two follow-up runs overlapping extra HTTP-worker initialization; tests run sequentially without competing test downloads; fresh cookie jar and browser process where applicable; same ten M12205 Other Documents; SHA-256 and filenames checked against a common reference
methodology.timingIncludes: Session or Chrome initialization, initializing 1 or 3 independent UI states, search, category enumeration, export requests, complete disk writes, SHA-256 checks, closing download dialogs
methodology.timingExcludes: Browser shutdown, ZIP creation, email sending, implementation/research time
caveats: Small exploratory benchmark, not a statistical performance guarantee
Fresh client sessions; server-side cache state is uncontrolled
Final replay uses state-based polling rather than the earlier fixed 180ms delay
Parallel DOM baseline still timed out after adding stable document IDs and waiting for dialog closure; its failed runs are excluded from speed comparisons, and retained in the raw results

Send observed initialization, resize and CSS-ack RPCs

Generate and download export resources with the same cookies
